citation: Decembrino et al. (2021), Synthesis of (−)-deoxypodophyllotoxin and (−)-epipodophyllotoxin via a multi-enzyme cascade in E. coli, Microbial Cell Factories 20:158, DOI 10.1186/s12934-021-01673-5
claim_text: Bounded reconstruction target: reported deoxypodophyllotoxin production of 196 µM (78 mg/L), corresponding to 98% theoretical yield from 200 µM matairesinol.

dependencies.notes: Publisher supplies supplementary PDF containing DNA sequences, plasmid information, methods, calibration description, and supporting figures/tables. Preserve citation and hash only when a local copy is intentionally acquired.
Reported substrate input is 200 µM matairesinol for the bounded conversion/yield claim.
Resolve exact enzyme identities, variants, expression constructs, host and relevant redox-partner state from manuscript and SI.
Audit the previously observed manuscript/SI accession-version discrepancy for deoxypodophyllotoxin synthase before recording any inconsistency finding.

Publication describes LC/MS analysis; public package must be audited for raw chromatographic/peak-area observations needed for independent quantitative reconstruction. Do not infer absence beyond the audited public artifacts.
SI describes sesamin internal calibration over 10–300 µM. Determine whether calibration observations/model parameters sufficient to recompute 196 µM are publicly available.
Audit numerical conversion from 196 µM deoxypodophyllotoxin to 78 mg/L against the stated chemical identity/molar mass.
Audit reported 98% theoretical yield from 196 µM product and 200 µM substrate under the publication's stated stoichiometric assumptions.
